metadata.name: InquiryBillPayPayee
metadata.description: Use this API to return element details for a specific Payee or Transfer account for a given subscriber.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: SubscriberID
request_fields.description: This is the Service Provider's (iPay Solutions) identifier  for the Cardholder User. Example : 12345678

request_fields.name: PayeeId
request_fields.description: This is the Payee identifier associated with the Payee or Transfer account for the Bill Pay Services API. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 20

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: SubscriberId
children.description: This is the Service Provider's (iPay Solutions) identifier for the Cardholder User. Example : 12345678

children.name: PayeeId
children.description: This is the Payee identifier associated with the Payee or Transfer account for the Bill Pay Services API. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 20

children.name: PayeeName
children.description: This is the name of the Payee Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PayeeNickname
children.description: This is the nickname for the Payee. Example: Andy Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PhoneNumber
children.description: This is the phone number, including area code, for the Payee. This is a numeric field that will not accept hyphens. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9812338769 Allowable Values: 15

children.name: PhoneType
children.description: This is the type of phone number for the payee. Valid Values: Work, SMS Example :Work, SMS Allowable Values: 10

children.name: RoutingNumber
children.description: This is the Bank Routing Number (ABA number) of the Individual Payee's bank (deposit) account Valid Values:0-9 Example: 0110000015 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: This is the individual Payee's bank account number. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 3002151478 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountType
children.description: This is the type of funding account. Valid values are: D – Checking(default value) S – Savings Example: D, S. Condition: This field is mandatory when the 'PayeeClsf' is 'Indv' (Individual/Person) Allowable Values: 10

children.name: NameOfAccount
children.description: This is the account name (given by the Cardholder User) for the default Bill Pay funding account(‘pay from account’) to be used to make payments to the specified Payee or Transfer account. Example: Andrew_123 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: P2PType
children.description: This is the type of communication method to be used for person-to-person Payee contact. Valid Values: SMS , Email. Example: SMS , Email. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PayeeClsf
children.description: This is the type of communication method to be used for person-to-person Payee contact. Valid Values: Comp(Company), Indv(Individual/Person) Example: Comp, Indv. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AddressModel
children.description: This model is to add address like address 1,2 state and Postal code.

children.name: AddressType
children.description: This is the  address  type for the payee. The Payee’s primary (i.e., payment remittance) address is required when adding a new Payee. Valid values are: Prim - Primary(default) Rush - Rush Allowable Values: 10

children.name: Addressline1
children.description: This is the street address for the payee. Example: One Main St Allowable Values: 100

children.name: Addressline2
children.description: This is the second line of the street address for the payee. Example: Apt A Allowable Values: 100

children.name: City
children.description: This is the city for the payee. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 75

children.name: State
children.description: This is the 2-character alpha code approved by the USPS which represents a state for the payee. Example: GA Valid values are A-Z, a-z Allowable Values: 5

children.name: Postalcode
children.description: This is the postal or ZIP code for the payee. (ZIP+4 is supported.) Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ActivationIntentKey
children.description: This is the Activation key is used to Update/Delete the Payee Example: B6F8CC9B-7BFC-469B-BD4C-2CA520FA0A9F Allowable Values: 100

children.name: PayeeStaus
children.description: This is the status of the Payee or Transfer account. Valid Values: Act- Activated(payments can be scheduled and processed for this payee) NotAct- Not activated(pending; payments cannot be scheduled) Dlt- Deleted(payee is not available for scheduling payments) Example: Act, NotAct, Dlt. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: EstimatedArrivalDay
children.description: This is the number of transit days required for a check payment to be delivered to this Payee. This is affected by the Payee's payment method and ZIP Code, as well as applicable Non-Processing Days. This value is added to the First Available Process Date to determine an Estimated Arrival Date. Example : 2, 5, 7, etc.

children.name: CategoryId
children.description: This is the name of the category assigned to the Payee or Transfer account Valid Values:0-9 Example: 2

children.name: PayeePmtMethodType
children.description: This is the payment method for the Payee associated with the processed payment or Transfer. Valid Values: Chk - Check Elec - Electronic Example: Chk, Elec. Allowable Values: 10
